## Scope check

Claudio is macOS-only and offline-first by design. Please confirm:

- [ ] This doesn't require a network call or external API
- [ ] This doesn't require changes to the upstream Kokoro model/runtime
      (those belong in [kokoro-onnx](https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx))
- [ ] This fits within the "wrapper script + menubar app" surface area

If any of those are "no," it's probably better filed upstream or as a
separate project — but feel free to open anyway and we can talk through it.
